rationale: Attempt-02 (64,128,32,stages=2,swizzle=16) improved simulated latency slightly to 1597.23 us with DRAM roughly flat at 269.68 MB versus attempt-01 (1616.24 us, 269.75 MB); both use swizzle=16 and 32768 B actual smem, so serpentine locality correlates with the big step from baseline but stages>=2 gave only marginal further gain. Large tiles with swizzle>0 now dominate observed DRAM/latency, so we keep raised traffic/pipeline weights (1.5) relative to launches/footprint, keep the 32768-byte portability cap, and keep the full tile/stage/swizzle domains (all divide M=N=K=4096) to test untried points such as block_M=128 with swizzle>0 and block_N=64/128. All three prior tuples are excluded, so HiGHS must pick a new configuration. Next hypothesis: block_M=128 with swizzle in {8,16} and stages in {2,3} may reduce simulated traffic/latency further via larger serpentine panels; if simulator DRAM/latency does not improve, revert weights toward uniform. Proxy cost is dimensionless ranking only, not microseconds; Metal checks execute exact source/config/TIR but CUDA binaries are not executed, GB10 values are simulator estimates not hardware measurements, and no global optimality is claimed.
